enchantments.tooltip: Dexterity +11: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +11 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Good Luck +3: This item gives a +3 Luck bonus to all saves and skill checks.
Underwater Action: This item grants the wearer the ability to breathe water as if it were air.
